Run XCMS preprocessing

runXCMSProcessing.Rd

Run XCMS preprocessing

Usage

runXCMSProcessing(
  files_dir,
  cwp = NULL,
  pdp = NULL,
  obi = ObiwarpParam(),
  sample_name = NULL,
  sample_group = NULL,
  BPPARAM = BiocParallel::SerialParam()
)

Arguments

files_dir

Path to directory containing mzXML or mzML files.

cwp

CentWaveParam. NULL = defaults for Bruker maXis HD / UHPLC / positive ESI.

pdp

PeakDensityParam. NULL = defaults.

obi

ObiwarpParam for RT alignment. Pass NULL to skip (single file or pre-aligned data).

sample_name

Character vector, one name per file. NULL = basenames.

sample_group

Character vector of group labels, parallel to sample_name. Example: c(rep("WT",3), rep("KO",3)).

BPPARAM

BiocParallelParam. Default SerialParam(). Parallelise with SnowParam(workers = 4).

Value

Named list: x_exp (XcmsExperiment) and pd (sample metadata DataFrame).
